items.title: Tractor Supply Retrenches; Strong Earnings Power Stocks to New Highs
items.summary: The farm-and-ranch chain Tractor Supply made a strategic pivot this summer, after its executives spent months debating whether inflation and other pressures squeezing their customers would be short-lived.  Background and context: The decision last month follows consecutive earnings misses and scraps targets set in December 2024, after a five-year run where sales surged 80%.  The goals covered everything from targets for store openings to sales figures and margins to 2030, and they were increasingly challenging to meet in the current environment, Chief Financial Officer Kurt Barton told Jennifer.

items.title: Tractor Supply Retrenches as It Looks for a Rebound
items.summary: The farm-and-ranch chain is lowering prices, closing pet-specialty stores and scaling back expansion as its shoppers have delayed some purchases.

items.title: Tractor Supply CEO Lawton Buys 15,600 Shares for $501,540 Amid Stock's 44% Decline
items.summary: Lawton's indirect acquisition through an Irrevocable Trust boosted his total beneficial ownership to 541,591 shares, a 3% increase in equity position. The stock has declined 44% over the past year.

items.title: Tractor Supply (TSCO) Cuts Its 2026 Outlook, Is The Stock A Bargain?
items.summary: Tractor Supply (TSCO) has drawn fresh investor attention after cutting its 2026 outlook and withdrawing its long term financial framework. items.title: TSCO Cuts 2026 Outlook as Demand Weakens and Higher Costs Persist
items.summary: Tractor Supply cuts its 2026 sales, comp and earnings outlook as weak discretionary demand and higher costs pressure near-term results.

items.title: TSCO Jumps 13% in a Month. Can Its Rebound Keep Gaining Momentum?
items.summary: Tractor Supply's 13% monthly rebound faces soft discretionary demand and cost pressure, even as digital growth, store investments and pet initiatives offer support.

items.title: Is TSCO a Buy After Its Valuation Reset and Earnings Estimate Cuts?
items.summary: Tractor Supply trades below its historical valuation, but falling earnings estimates and soft discretionary demand keep the near-term buy case in check.

items.title: Tractor Supply Director Hawaux Buys 3,150 Shares Amid 44% Decline
items.summary: Hawaux expanded his total beneficial ownership by 21% through indirect trust acquisition, signaling confidence during a period of significant stock weakness.
